picojson 1.3.0
Source: https://github.com/kazuho/picojson/blob/v1.3.0/picojson.h
License: BSD 2-Clause, reproduced in picojson.h.
Local change: The default assertion macro throws std::runtime_error.
This change lets the desktop command report invalid input without an abort.
